thread.title: IWB, LQDH: Big ETF Outflows

author: BNK Invest
title: IWB, LQDH: Big ETF Outflows
text:
Shutterstock photo Looking at units outstanding versus one week prior within the universe of ETFs covered at ETF Channel, the biggest outflow was seen in the iShares Russell 1000 ETF ( IWB ), where 17,050,000 units were destroyed, or a 13.0% decrease week over week. Among the largest underlying components of IWB, in morning trading today Apple ( AAPL ) is up about 1.1%, and Microsoft ( MSFT ) is higher by about 1.2%.
And on a percentage change basis, the ETF with the biggest outflow was the iShares Interest Rate Hedged Corporate Bond ETF ( LQDH ), which lost 700,000 of its units, representing a 25.5% decline in outstanding units compared to the week prior.
